title: AI Resume Analyser
description: Full-stack application integrating Claude Sonnet via Puter.js for AI-powered resume analysis. Features cloud file storage, user authentication, and client-side PDF-to-image conversion using PDF.js. Deployed on Vercel.

title: Bicycle Sharing App
description: A bicycle sharing application enabling riders to hire and return bicycles at stations, with secure verification and real-time tracking.

title: Netflix Clone
description: A streaming platform clone allowing users to browse movie listings with descriptions and watch integrated trailers, built with a Netflix-inspired UI.
